answer: A Sybil-resistant AI-agent economy can make each identity burn a scarce opal token and lock a bond at a trusted vertex of a staking graph, then auditors sample a random delta of that agent's recent attestations and slash the whole bond if any proof is forged. A fresh identity always needs its own opal burn and its own bond, so an attacker buying N fake votes must pay N registrations plus N locked stakes: the cost scales linearly with Sybils while each forged voice still counts once.
